patch_description: Redesign the ANSATZ_SPEC to aggressively share parameters across the entire per-block layout. This reduces the parameter budget per block from 11+ keys (66 total) to 5 unique keys, yielding 30 total trainable parameters (5 keys × 3 uploads × 2 repeats). The structure maintains the same data flow and outputs, but increases parameter efficiency and enforces stronger symmetry by sharing pre/post rotations across all wires, while preserving the ring (CRY) and hub (CRX) entangling motifs. The gating remains within the allowed edge-adjacent connectivity, and the overall depth and gate count are reduced without changing the fixed training loop or feature map semantics.
